budget_items.topic: ADU fee as percentage of standard fee
budget_items.what_was_said: A commissioner suggested that if an ADU is roughly half the size of the house, the ADU fee could be set at half of what was charged for the original hookup.

minutes.headline: Sewer Commission opened discussion on charging a fee for accessory dwelling unit (ADU) sewer hookups, with no fee set yet
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Sewer Commission received updates on the Dana Street pump station repair and a manhole-repair bid, discussed disposing of old files, and addressed a Munis billing-system glitch that was adding incorrect late fees to quarterly demands. Most of the meeting was spent on an early, unresolved discussion of whether and how to charge a hookup fee for accessory dwelling units (ADUs), with commissioners agreeing to research other towns' approaches before returning to the topic.

what_happened.line: Commission discussed charging accessory dwelling units a sewer hookup fee, tentatively favoring half the standard fee, but set no fee.
A Munis billing update had added an incorrect late fee to overdue quarterly sewer demands; the business manager reversed the erroneous charges before bills go out.
Dana Street pump station bypass repair work is tentatively scheduled to begin June 30.
Manhole repair work is tentatively scheduled to begin in July, pending a compliance review.
About 48 boxes of old files dating to 1994 are being disposed of, with the state notified; no commission vote was needed.

why_it_matters: Any accessory-dwelling-unit sewer fee the commission eventually adopts would be a new charge on property owners adding such units, and none has been set yet.
A billing-system error that misapplied late fees on quarterly sewer demands was caught and corrected before bills went out, so no ratepayer should see the wrong charge on this cycle's demand.
The pump station and manhole repairs are maintenance work on existing sewer infrastructure, not new costs described in this meeting.
watch_next: Research from other towns (e.g., Fitchburg, Leominster) on ADU sewer fees, to be brought back to the commission
Next meetings: July 8, July 29, August 12, August 26

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree closely on the substance: the Dana Street and manhole schedules, the file disposal, the ADU research and the future agenda items. Our minutes misspell several names, mishear or garble the ADU fee figures, and give Dan Proctor and Scott Dollar the ADU research task as a decision, while the official minutes have them each checking with a different outside body. A reader should check the official minutes on one point: they record roll-call votes on the 6/10/25 minutes and on adjournment, but not on the ADU fee approach.
